name: Spies of Mordor
game_text:
<keyword>Search</keyword>. To play, spot a <culture>Sauron</culture> Orc. Plays to your support area.
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may draw a card (or 2 cards if you can spot a <culture>Sauron</culture> tracker).
flavor_text: “‘Mordor Orcs patrol the Eastern Shore. We must wait for the cover of darkness.’”
